# Saim Dev — Next.js Web Architecture & Takeaway Systems

> Saim Dev is a specialized Next.js studio based in Pakistan that builds bespoke, high-performance websites and digital takeaway systems for small businesses across the United Kingdom and Europe. All projects are delivered remotely with fixed GBP pricing, sub-second page performance, and built-in technical SEO.

## Studio Overview & Commercial Details

- **Studio Name**: Saim Dev
- **Founder & Lead Developer**: Saim Dev
- **Primary Domain**: https://www.saimdev.site
- **Geographic Focus**: United Kingdom & European Union (remote service delivery)
- **Email**: contact@saimdev.site
- **WhatsApp**: +92 319 6526604
- **Fixed Pricing Model**:
  - Landing Page Plan: £250 (Single high-converting page, 3-5 days delivery)
  - Starter Plan: £390 (Multi-page business website, 5-7 days delivery)
  - Business / Takeaway Plan: £790 (Full custom web app, online menu/ordering, 7-10 days delivery)

## Core Technologies

- Next.js (App Router, Server Components)
- React & TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Edge Cloud Hosting (Vercel, Cloudflare)
- Structured Data (Schema.org JSON-LD)
